title: Red light on the mesa

tellings.quote: We look over at the mesa and there's this red light and we're like, "Oh man, what is that? Someone's out there." Well, then all of a sudden,

plain: A witness who is not named says that near Aztec, New Mexico, he and others looked over at a mesa and saw a red light, and at first thought someone was out there, "then all of a sudden" something happened, though the quoted words stop there. He tells it first-hand on an episode about a claimed crash of a craft carrying 16 alien bodies in that area, and he offers it as a strange sight in the same place.
